crossRefs.note: Behold, he travails with iniquity. Yes, he has conceived mischief, and brought out falsehood.
No one sues in righteousness, and no one pleads in truth. They trust in vanity, and speak lies. They conceive mischief…
They hatch adders’ eggs, and weave the spider’s web. He who eats of their eggs dies; and that which is crushed breaks…
You have plowed wickedness. You have reaped iniquity. You have eaten the fruit of lies, for you trusted in your way, in…
Don’t be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.

Then the lust, when it has conceived, bears sin. The sin, when it is full grown, produces death.

translations.web: They conceive mischief, and produce iniquity. Their heart prepares deceit.”
translations.bsb: They conceive trouble and give birth to evil; their womb is pregnant with deceit.”
translations.kjv: They conceive mischief, and bring forth vanity, and their belly prepareth deceit.
translations.asv: They conceive mischief, and bring forth iniquity, And their heart prepareth deceit.
